name: partner-store-onboarding-lifecycle
objective: توحيد Business Vertical وdraft lifecycle وediting authority وintake/publication readiness لملف الانضمام الميداني عبر App Field وPartners Control Panel وPartner readback.
truthOwner: DSH owns partner/store onboarding state; central business-vertical/catalog registries own classification; Control Panel reviews but does not silently rewrite field provenance.

tasks.objective: Converge onboarding classification and lifecycle on one canonical DSH model and all related Control Panel pages/tabs.
tasks.currentProblem: Local category/default can diverge from central catalog, and lifecycle/edit authority can be implicit across field and partner review screens.
tasks.requiredChange: Introduce/reuse canonical Business Vertical registry binding, explicit draft/review states, edit permissions per state, separate intake-complete from publication-ready, and migrate compatible data forward without rewriting applied history.
tasks.targetState: Field captures one draft, Partners reviews the same object, returned changes reopen field editing, approved object retains IDs, and no default/invalid vertical can publish.
tasks.action: Trace existing model/API/DB/UI, consolidate competing fields/states, update ReviewQueue/PartnerDetail/StoreManagement and field onboarding screens, add migration/backfill where required, and remove obsolete duplicated state after compatibility is proven.
mustNotChange: لا silent operator edit أثناء DRAFT/SUBMITTED.
لا نشر vertical غير محسوم أو default.
لا إعادة إنشاء IDs بين الأسطح.
acceptanceCriteria: Business Vertical canonical ومطلوبة قبل submit/publish حسب السياسة.
state machine موحدة على Field/Control Panel.
editing authority تتغير حسب state وتدقق.
جميع صفحات وتبويبات Partners المرتبطة تعرض نفس الحالة.
Partner app يقرأ نفس approved store identity.
tasks.rollback: Use forward-compatible migration rollback/roll-forward preserving draft history and IDs.
